The '''Legion of Alderaan''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] military unit during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were known for their [[Battle Chant of the Legion of Alderaan|battle chant]].
